La <strong>Acción Clave 1 (KA1)</strong>: Key Action 1 (KA1) is the gateway to Erasmus+ for most organisations. It funds learning mobility: stays in another country to study, train, teach or gain experience. It is the most accessible action and the one with the most direct impact on participants.
KA1 cubre los costes de organizar y real: KA1 covers the costs of organising and carrying out mobility: travel, subsistence, organisational support and, where relevant, language and inclusion support. Depending on the sector, this means:
<strong>Educación superior:</strong> est: Higher education: stays for students and for teaching and administrative staff.
<strong>Formación profesional (FP):</str: Vocational education and training (VET): placements for learners and mobility for trainers.
<strong>Educación escolar y de personas: School and adult education: training and job-shadowing for teachers.
<strong>Juventud:</strong> intercambios: Youth: youth exchanges and mobility for youth workers.
Centros educativos, entidades de FP, ONG: Schools, VET providers, NGOs, local councils and youth organisations. Many take part through Erasmus+ accreditation, which gives simplified, recurring access to mobility funding without competing in every call.
Define el perfil de tus participantes y: Define your participants' profile and the learning objectives, identify host organisations in other countries and consider whether applying for accreditation suits you. La <strong>Acción Clave 2 (KA2)</strong>: Key Action 2 (KA2) funds cooperation between organisations from different countries to develop, share and transfer innovative practices. If KA1 moves people, KA2 moves ideas and projects: it is where European consortia are built and lasting results are produced.
<strong>Asociaciones de cooperación:</st: Cooperation partnerships: larger, more ambitious projects for experienced organisations that want to innovate and scale up results.
<strong>Asociaciones de pequeña escala:<: Small-scale partnerships: smaller budgets and lighter requirements, designed for small organisations or newcomers to the programme. The best way to start.

Una <strong>asociación equilibrada</stro: A balanced partnership, where every partner contributes and benefits.

Erasmus+ KA3: apoyo a la reforma de las: Erasmus+ KA3: support for European policy reform
La <strong>Acción Clave 3 (KA3)</strong>: Key Action 3 (KA3) is the least known but the most strategic: it funds support for policy development and cooperation. Its aim is to connect what happens on the ground with the European policy agenda, so that good practice influences how education, training and youth policies are designed.
¿Qué tipo de iniciativas apoya?: What kind of initiatives does it support?
Proyectos que prueban <strong>enfoques i: Projects that test innovative policy approaches on a small scale before they are rolled out more widely.
<strong>Diálogo con la juventud</strong>: Youth dialogue and young people's participation in the decisions that affect them.
Acciones de <strong>sensibilización, red: Awareness-raising, networking and cooperation activities around European priorities.
Sobre todo a <strong>administraciones pú: Mainly public authorities, European networks and experienced organisations with the capacity to influence policy. Much of KA3 is managed through specific calls at European level rather than by the national agencies.
